answer: Cross-Epoch Drift Scoring. Each identity’s actions are scored per epoch, and the score is compared against its own prior-epoch distribution; an identity whose behavioural vector shifts beyond a ridge of tolerance without corresponding external events has its trust weight decayed. A beacon transaction must periodically re-anchor the identity’s history to a fresh epoch. Maintaining many sockpuppets forces each to sustain independent, costly consistent histories across epochs, and any abrupt pivot (the willow-like bend attackers need to reuse cheap identities) resets accumulated weight,
